summary: Siskiyou NF lookout in Curry County, OR: L-5 cab built 1934, replaced by an L-4 tower in 1940, staffed in 1941; the tower is gone and no source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-5 cab (1934), replaced in 1940 by an L-4 tower
facts.status_note: Tower reported gone; no source we read describes what remains at the site
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Siskiyou National Forest

events.note: L-5 cab replaced by an L-4 tower on a spur about a mile WSW of the summit
Staffed 84 days; reported to the Gold Beach station by telephone
Registered April 21, 2011; nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.supports: L-5 cab built 1934, replaced 1940 by an L-4 tower on a spur WSW of the summit
evidence.quote: An L-5 cab, built in 1934, was replaced in 1940 with an L-4 tower atop a spur one mile WSW of the summit.
1934: L-5 cab. 1940: L-4 tower. Emergency 1965. Gone.

evidence.supports: Siskiyou National Forest, Curry County, Oregon
staffed 84 days in 1941; reported to Gold Beach station by telephone
evidence.quote: 1941: The lookout staffed for 84 days and reported to the Gold Beach station via West Coast Telephone Company.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the FFLA list both describe a tower, and the 1940 L-4 tower fits that. The tree label in the record's other source is not supported by the pages we read.

notes_for_editor: Record location (FFLOS 42.27437, -124.19921) is about 1.3 km from the second point in the record (west_us_lookouts 42.27511, -124.21481). Neither page read gives coordinates, so the FFLOS point is kept. The tree kind label was not checked against its own source page. No source gives a removal date. Searches for Siskiyou lookout histories found nothing else on Three Trees. No access or current-condition information found.
